newsitem.title: USA: Duke 1129 MW S.C. nuke resumes power output.
newsitem.headline: Duke 1129 MW S.C. nuke resumes power output.

text.p: Duke Power Co's 1,129 megawatt Catawba nuclear power unit 1 resumed power output over the weekend and was synchronizing to the electricity grid early Monday, the Nuclear Regulatory Commission (NRC) said.
The unit, in Clover, S.C., was operating at eight percent of capacity and was "holding power while placing turbine online," as of early Monday, the NRC said in its daily plant status report.
Catawba 1 was taken off line late Thursday due to a leak in a small reactor coolant pump.
Duke Power is the operator of the Catawba plant.
